mapper.sql: est01_pf_fee_type_id AS pf_fee_type_id, est01_fee_cd AS fee_code, a.sys09_name AS fee_name, a.sys09_desc AS fee_desc, est01_seq AS seq, est01_start_date AS start_date, est01_close_date AS close_date, est01_note AS note

FROM est01_pf_fee_type INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM sys09_code INNER JOIN sys08_code_kind ON sys08_code_kind_id = sys09_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'EstPfFeeCode' ) a ON est01_fee_cd = a.sys09_code
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE 1=1 AND est01_company_id = #{companyId} AND #{startDate} BETWEEN est01_start_date AND COALESCE(est01_close_date, TO_DATE('29991231', 'yyyyMMdd')) AND UPPER(CONCAT(sys09_name, sys09_desc)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO est01_pf_fee_type (est01_pf_fee_type_id, est01_company_id, est01_fee_cd, est01_start_date, est01_close_date, est01_seq, est01_note) VALUES (#{id}, #{companyId}, #{r.feeCode}, #{r.startDate}, #{r.closeDate}, #{r.seq}, #{r.note})
mapper.select: SELECT est02_pf_contract_id FROM est02_pf_contract WHERE est02_pf_fee_type_id IN #{pfFeeTypeId}
